scope.quote: The vault stores one configured owner address. A caller whose address differs from the configured owner address can call withdraw. The intended authorization rule is that a withdrawal may complete only when the caller address equals the configured owner address. Because the withdrawal path omits this authorization check, the unauthorized call completes successfully instead of reverting.
An unauthorized caller can complete the withdrawal and receive vault funds.
